glossary.ja: アルバート・ライネン
glossary.role: Former UCE scientist who warned of alien invasion and led the satellite-cannon defense project (Rainen Project) before being forced out; his name heads the antagonist 'Rainen forces'. Barkholz's father.
glossary.personality: Visionary 'ignored expert' embittered by the UCE's dismissal of his warnings.

glossary.role: Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: U.N. Spacy VF-1 variable fighter series.

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.role: Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).

Former UCE scientist who warned of alien invasion and led the satellite-cannon defense project (Rainen Project) before being forced out; his name heads the antagonist 'Rainen forces'. Barkholz's father.
glossary.personality: Visionary 'ignored expert' embittered by the UCE's dismissal of his warnings.

glossary.role: Earth's name for the unknown Jovian enemy (actually the Jovian Federation, 木連).
Main antagonist of 0083; Zeon ace "Nightmare of Solomon", Delaz Fleet pilot who steals Gundam GP02 and later pilots the Neue Ziel. Rank: Major (U.C. 0083).
glossary.personality: Honorable, idealistic career soldier; charismatic leader who fights on the front line; hates the Federation but respects worthy opponents.

glossary.role: ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

33.speaker: Kouichiro Misumaru
33.evidence: brief: '私はＵＣＥ宇宙軍提督のミスマルだ。'

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ライネン#cの<im(1)>配下と思われる#c[BE5050]武装集団#cは、
現在までに各地で確認されている。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]Rainen#c's presumed <im(1)>followers in the
#c[BE5050]armed faction#c have now been confirmed
across various regions.

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(2)>まだ大きな動きは見せてはいないが、
小規模な勢力だけに、その動きは
神出鬼没だ。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(2)>They haven't made major moves yet, but
as a small force, their movements
are elusive and unpredictable.

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>「地球圏に脅威を与える勢力」…
#c[BE5050]ライネン#cが言及していたその言葉が、
彼らの行動の目的を探るカギとなるだろう。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>"Forces threatening the Earth Sphere"...
Those words mentioned by #c[BE5050]Rainen#c will be
the key to discovering their true objective.

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(4)>すぐに思い当たるのが、#c[BE5050]木星蜥蜴#cや
#c[BE5050]ポセイダル#cなどの地球圏外からの
敵対勢力だが…それだけではない。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(4)>The #c[BE5050]Jovian Lizards#c and #c[BE5050]Poseidal#c
from beyond the Sphere come to mind,
but they are not the only ones.

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>未知の勢力に備えた戦艦#c[5E8FD8]マクロス#cと
新兵器#c[5E8FD8]バルキリー部隊#c…
…お、おっと、この話はタブーだったな。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>The #c[5E8FD8]Macross#c and new #c[5E8FD8]Valkyrie squad#c,
readied for unknown threats...
...Oops, that topic is off-limits.
rows.notes: Misumaru revealing classified info on Macross. fix: line length exceeded 430px -> compacted into three lines

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(5)>地上においても！
#c[BE5050]ドレイク軍#c、#c[BE5050]リクレイマー#cなどの勢力が
活動を激しくしてきている。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(5)>Even on Earth, forces like
#c[BE5050]Drake's army#c and the #c[BE5050]Reclaimers#c
have stepped up their activities!

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>それらの敵勢力に対して、何らかの行動を
起こそうとしていることは確かだ。
何とかして、それを掴まねばな。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)>It's clear they plan to take action against
those hostile forces. Somehow,
we must uncover what they're after.

rows.jp:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(9)>#c[5E8FD8]諜報部#cも、懸命に捜査してくれている。
報告書には、こまめに目を通しておいて
くれたまえ。
rows.en:
<op(33,1)><sp(2)><im(9)>#c[5E8FD8]Intelligence#c is investigating vigorously.
Please make sure to review their reports
thoroughly.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>「ライネンの動向」

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　プリベンター　レディ・アン
rows.en:
<sp(0)>"Rainen Movements"

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　Preventer Lady Une

rows.jp:
<sp(0)><im(1)>先日#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#cに対して宣戦布告した
#c[BE5050]アルバート・ライネン#cと#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#cの
<im(4)>繋がりが、今回の件で明らかとなった。
rows.en:
<sp(0)><im(1)>The link between the foe of the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c,
#c[BE5050]Albert Rainen#c, and the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c<im(4)>
has become clear through this incident.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>彼が言及する「かねてよりの計画」とは、
同機による#c[E2E258]ライネンプロジェクト<im(2)>#cの再興
であると考えて間違いない。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>His "long-prepared plan" undoubtedly refers
to reviving the #c[E2E258]Rainen Project<im(2)>#c
with that very machine.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>また#c[5E8FD8]設計局#cへの照会の結果、彼らが
所持する機体は全て、大戦前に#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#cで
開発されていたタイプであることが判明。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Inquiries to the #c[5E8FD8]Design Bureau#c showed
that all units they held were types
developed by the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c before the war.
rows.notes: Preventer report. fix: line length exceeded 430px -> compacted into three lines

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>これらの事実から、#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#c対策本部は
#c[BE5050]アルバート・ライネン#cが今回の一連の件<im(3)>
の首謀者であることが確実と判断した。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>From these facts, the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c Task Force
concluded that #c[BE5050]Albert Rainen#c is definitely
the mastermind behind these incidents.<im(3)>

rows.jp: <sp(0)>彼は、過去から蘇ったのである。
rows.en: <sp(0)>He has returned from the past.

report.translator_summary: Translated Operation 15 Batch 02 (24 rows), concluding Operation 15. Covers the decisive realization by Tak that the enemy commander from Torrington Base is alive and that Marina deliberately staged the incident in Op 01 to join Rainen. Debriefing from Admiral Misumaru reviews the alien and Earth factions and accidentally mentions the classified Macross and Valkyrie units, followed by Lady Une's Preventer report confirming Rainen's revival of the Rainen Project.
